question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **looked**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"looked"** refers to directing one's eyes towards something in order to observe or perceive it. (देखा)

 
 
• **Example: **She looked out the window and saw the sunset.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **looked**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Glanced** (झलक): A quick or brief look at something.

 
 
• **Example:** He glanced at the clock before running out the door.
 
 
 
• **See** (देखना): The act of perceiving with the eyes, typically used in the present tense or for general observation.
 
 
• **Example:** I can see the stars clearly tonight.
 
 
 
• **Observed** (निरीक्षण करना): To watch carefully, often to study or analyze something.
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist observed the experiment for hours to note the results.
